title: Acelepryn G Insecticide - Grub and Armyworm Control
description:
Acelepryn G granular insecticide lets you say goodbye to pesky lawn invaders. This powerful formula wipes out harmful pests like caterpillars and grubs. This insecticide among the safest for pollinators and earthworms. Acelepryn gives your lawn the defense it needs to thrive. It's a cost-effective solution for residential and commercial turf.

  • One application provides long-lasting insect control
  • Effective against turf caterpillars, grubs, and more
  • Safe for use on all types of grass
  • Covers up to 21,000 square feet, saving time and money
